Assets\_Game\Editor\ChunkRendererUpgrade.cs(16,26): warning CS0618: 'Object.FindObjectsByType<T>(FindObjectsInactive, FindObjectsSortMode)' is obsolete: 'FindObjectsByType with FindObjectsSortMode parameter has been deprecated.
